title: LongAlign: A Recipe for Long Context Alignment of Large Language Models
authors_zh: Yushi Bai, Xin Lv, Jiajie Zhang, Yuze He, Ji Qi, Lei Hou, Jie Tang, Yuxiao Dong, Juanzi Li
paper_type_zh: 开放指令数据集与构造方法研究

one_line: LongAlign-10k packages long documents, instructions, and answers with length-aware training metadata.
LongAlign-10k 将长文档、指令与回答连同长度感知训练元数据一起发布。
why: treating context-length distribution and batch grouping as auditable properties of an instruction dataset
inclusion_reason: LongAlign-10k is a public Track 01 training object: long context, instruction, assistant answer, and length or packing-group metadata; it is consumed by long-context instruction SFT with sorted or packed batching.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Extending positional capacity does not teach a model to follow instructions over long documents, and naive batching makes 64K-context SFT inefficient and unstable.

The paper's decision boundary is the released LongAlign-10k training object, not a model-only report or an evaluation-only benchmark. One record contains long context, instruction, assistant answer, and length or packing-group metadata; its selection boundary is length and format checks, response review, and long-context benchmark evaluation, and the records are consumed by long-context instruction SFT with sorted or packed batching.

L4 facts: the official Findings of EMNLP 2024 page, public records at https://huggingface.co/datasets/THUDM/LongAlign-10k, release scale and terms were checked on 2026-07-27. The paper is included because its central contribution directly constructs or curates serialized post-training targets.

扩展位置编码并不能自动教会模型处理长文档指令，朴素批处理还会让 64K 上下文微调低效且不稳定。

LongAlign 发布 1 万条长上下文指令记录，并配合按长度分组与损失加权，减少填充浪费和序列长度偏差。 该方法直接产出 LongAlign-10k。本卡的决策边界是可下载训练记录，而不是只有模型的报告或只用于评测的基准；单条记录包含 长上下文、指令、助手回答以及长度或分组元数据。

L4 事实：已于 2026-07-27 核验 Findings of EMNLP 2024 官方页面、https://huggingface.co/datasets/THUDM/LongAlign-10k 的实际公开记录、规模和条款。收录理由是论文中心贡献直接构造或筛选可序列化的后训练目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
LongAlign releases 10K long-context instruction records and combines them with length-grouped batching and loss weighting so long and short examples can be trained without excessive padding or sequence bias. The closest comparison is short-context instruction tuning after positional interpolation and randomly batched long SFT; unlike that neighbor, the primary object here is LongAlign-10k and the feedback boundary is length and format checks, response review, and long-context benchmark evaluation, which makes this an instruction/demonstration data paper rather than a model-architecture-only entry.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: long documents paired with diverse question and task templates. Operation: Normalize source identifiers, media or task inputs, and target fields into the release schema. Output and transition: Candidate records containing long context, instruction, assistant answer, and length or packing-group metadata advance to target construction. Check / stop rule: Reject missing inputs, targets, or source provenance.

Step 2 - Write or transform the target. Input: The normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: a strong language model writes answers conditioned on the complete long context produces or supplies the target while preserving fields needed for audit. Output and transition: A serialized instruction, demonstration, caption, rationale, or response advances to verification. Check / stop rule: A target that cannot be tied back to its input or source annotation is not retained.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated or transformed candidates. Operation: Apply length and format checks, response review, and long-context benchmark evaluation; deduplicate and assign release splits where documented. Output and transition: Passing records form 10,000 long-context instruction records stored as JSON conversation records with long documents and length metadata and advance to training use. Check / stop rule: Keep only records that pass the stated correctness, grounding, format, or selection contract.

Step 4 - Consume the data. Input: The released records and the paper's chosen base model. Operation: Use them for long-context instruction SFT with sorted or packed batching and compare against short-context instruction tuning after positional interpolation and randomly batched long SFT. Output and transition: A trained checkpoint and controlled evidence about the data intervention become the final evaluated artifacts. Check / stop rule: Judge both target-task quality and regression on general capabilities; no universal early-stopping threshold is disclosed.

Reproducibility requires pinning source revisions, the public manifest, transformation prompts, teacher version, filters, split, base checkpoint, and evaluation harness. The complete generation budget is not disclosed.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：论文核验过的公开任务、媒体、文档或已有指令来源。 操作：统一来源编号、输入和目标字段，并保留追踪信息。 输出及流转：候选记录进入目标构造阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少输入、目标或来源信息的记录直接删除。

步骤 2——撰写或转换目标。 输入：规范化候选及其来源证据。 操作：LongAlign 发布 1 万条长上下文指令记录，并配合按长度分组与损失加权，减少填充浪费和序列长度偏差。 输出及流转：得到包含 长上下文、指令、助手回答以及长度或分组元数据 的结构化记录，并进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：不能回溯到输入、来源标注或生成轮次的目标不保留。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成或转换后的候选记录。 操作：按论文披露的正确性、执行结果、视觉落地、格式或质量信号筛选，并在有说明时去重和划分数据。 输出及流转：通过检查的 1 万条长上下文指令记录 以 带长文档和长度信息的 JSON 对话记录 发布，随后进入训练。 检查与停止规则：只有满足论文接受契约且必需字段完整的记录进入发布集。

步骤 4——消费数据。 输入：公开记录与论文采用的基础模型。 操作：按论文配方完成指令微调、蒸馏或相应后训练，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的检查点和数据干预的受控证据成为最终评估产物。 检查与停止规则：同时检查目标任务质量和通用能力回退；论文未披露统一早停阈值时不得自行补写。

复现时需固定来源修订版、公开清单、转换提示、教师版本、过滤器、切分、基础检查点和评测工具。完整端到端生成预算若未披露，应保留为未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under the paper's matched long-context backbone, LongAlign data and its training recipe improve long-document QA and retrieval benchmarks over position-extension-only and naive batching baselines; ablations separate data length diversity from packing efficiency.

Impact cross-check: OpenAlex reported 11 citations on 2026-07-27, and the official dataset exposes actual reusable records rather than only weights or examples. The count is an impact signal, not a Google Scholar citation line and not evidence that every record is correct.

在匹配的长上下文骨干下，LongAlign 数据与训练配方在长文档问答和检索评测上超过只扩展位置编码或随机批处理的基线；消融区分了长度多样性和分组效率。结论仍受文档类型和教师回答质量限制。

影响力交叉检查：OpenAlex 在 2026-07-27 报告 11 次引用，官方数据集也公开了可复用实际记录，而不是只有权重或样例。该数字只作为影响信号，不是 Google Scholar 引用数，也不能证明每条记录都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work baseline: short-context instruction tuning after positional interpolation and randomly batched long SFT. The actual change is treating context-length distribution and batch grouping as auditable properties of an instruction dataset. This is a direction signal because it changes the serialized data object and its selection contract, not merely the backbone. The inherited model family, source tasks, autoregressive loss, and common benchmarks are not new. Before reuse, inspect models can exploit position and document-template cues without integrating distant evidence.
相对最近的共同做法，把上下文长度分布和批次分组变成可审计的指令数据属性。 这改变了可审计的数据对象或选择决策，而不只是更换骨干模型。继承的模型家族、自回归训练目标和常用评测并不新；复用前还要检查 模型可能利用位置和文档模板线索，而未真正整合远距离证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Teacher answers can miss evidence deep in the context
  2. only 10K records cover limited document genres
  3. long-sequence training cost and source-document licenses constrain reproduction.

1. 教师回答可能遗漏上下文深处的证据。
  2. 1 万条记录只覆盖有限文档类型。
  3. 长序列训练成本和源文档许可限制复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For aligning an extended-context base model to follow long-document instructions, use the official manifest and schema to build a controlled SFT mixture. The output should be a versioned dataset and a fixed-backbone comparison; success requires the paper's task metrics plus an audit of models can exploit position and document-template cues without integrating distant evidence.
  • For data auditing, sample records across sources and reproduce the stated selection contract: length and format checks, response review, and long-context benchmark evaluation. Do not reuse the release when its licensing or source provenance cannot be preserved.

• 若要让已扩展上下文窗口的基础模型学会处理长文档指令，可复用官方清单、记录结构和论文披露的筛选配方。输出应是带版本的数据集与固定骨干对照；成功标准除论文指标外，还要审计 模型可能利用位置和文档模板线索，而未真正整合远距离证据。
  • 数据审计者应跨来源抽样，复查必需字段、接受规则和许可。若无法保留来源信息或执行相同检查，就不应直接复用。
